settings.maxRoundsHelp: A cap that prevents the game from running indefinitely when penalty chains loop. The game ends when either player runs out of cards or the max round is reached.
settings.speedHelp: How fast each play's animation runs while autoplaying. Faster races to the finish; slower lets each play out.

tutorial.cpuPile: CPU's card pile. Shows remaining card count.
tutorial.centralPile: The central pile. Penalty cards cause it to grow.
tutorial.playerPile: Your card pile. You lose when you run out of cards.
tutorial.stepButton: Press this button to play the next card.
tutorial.autoplayButton: Press this button to auto-play until the game ends.
